## Decision

Add an automated test asserting package.json check script includes check:pi, extend AGENTS-SKILLS-R-007 fit criterion to cover both conjuncts, and promote R-007 to automated.

## Rationale

For a requirement whose subject IS a build-configuration invariant, package.json is the artifact under test. A test reading the real package.json and failing when check:pi is removed is genuine automated verification — not inspection prose. The rejected option (b) — splitting clause 2 into a separate requirement — adds churn with no extra rigour and leaves the invariant unguarded during the split.

## Alternatives Considered

- (b) Split clause 2 into its own requirement with a new id, fit criterion, and annotation — more churn, no added rigour, leaves invariant unguarded during split
